caption: The drawing consists of two fan-shaped objects aligned vertically on a plain beige background, both resembling traditional hand fans. The upper object is an outline sketch of a fan, showing faint pencil lines that depict a group of figures seated together, surrounded by floral and decorative motifs. The lower object, directly beneath, is a more detailed and colored illustration of a similar fan. The top section of this fan is vividly painted with multiple seated and standing human figures in historical attire, gathered in an outdoor setting that includes blue sky and green foliage. The left and right edges of this fan feature numerous pink and white flowers against a green backdrop, bordered with a thin gold edge. The bottom half of this fan is filled with intricate lace-like patterns rendered in shades of gray, resembling filigree, with fine detailing throughout. At the fan’s center is a metallic-looking pivot with a gold-colored handle, from which a partially sketched tassel of intertwined threads hangs downward.
title: Fan
